essence: The officiant should give offerings to the Vidyeśas in sequence using each deity's own mantra.
Whatever is not explicitly stated here should be performed according to the procedure of the weighing-scale ascent rite.
The ritual confers comprehensive purification and protection by removing sin, fear, and famine.
Twice-born officiants may perform the rite either with half the standard measure or with one hundred niṣkas.
The ruby should be placed on the horn and the diamond on the tip of the hoof.
